name: Steelheart Cut
description: Cut from the sword heart with its calm weight behind the edge so the stroke lands without effort.

name: Steelheart Ward
description: Hold the sword heart still behind the blade so a shell of qi takes the blow and no tremor passes through.

name: Steelheart Pace
description: Move one measured pace with the heart held level so the blade keeps its line through the step.

name: Heartsteel Surge
description: Surge on the pulse of the sword heart and cut as the feet land so body and edge arrive as one.

name: Twin Heartsteel
description: Turn a blow with the first edge of the heart and cut with its twin before the blow has fully passed.

name: Heartsteel Sense
description: Open the sword heart outward to feel the beat of every blade and hand within a dozen paces.

name: Heartsteel Rend
description: Drive the full force of the sword heart through the edge in one stroke that rends guard and armor alike.

name: Heartsteel Aegis
description: Spread the calm of the sword heart as a shell about the wielder and its allies while it also steadies their cuts.

name: Sovereign Heartsteel
description: Gather the sword heart into both blades and cut once so the stroke parts the guard and presses down the target's qi.

name: Hawkblade Stoop
description: Fold the blade like a wing and drop it in a steep stoop onto the target's shoulder.

name: Hawkblade Wing
description: Open the blade and the off arm like folded wings to take a blow on a spread of qi.

name: Hawkblade Talon
description: Strike with the point curled like a talon to pierce a gap in the target's guard.

name: Hawkblade Glide
description: Glide low across the ground with the blade trailing like a pinion and close inside the target's reach.

name: Hawkblade Rise
description: Rise from the crouch in an upward cut that lifts the wielder's body with the stroke.

name: Wingspread Edge
description: Spread the edge wide to sweep a blow off line and return it as a broad cut across the chest.

name: Hawkblade Rake
description: Rake the point down the target's weapon arm in three claws of qi that spoil the grip.

name: Hawkblade Sight
description: Lift the blade and let qi sharpen the wielder's sight until every weak point in the target's stance shows.

name: Hawkblade Unfolding
description: Gather qi in the folded blade then open it in a wide sweep that cuts every foe within the arc.

name: Hawkblade Shroud
description: Wrap the wielder in the folded wings of qi and step clear of the line of attack beneath them.

name: Sovereign Hawkblade
description: Flash through the air on the blade like a stooping hawk and drive one piercing stroke through the target.

name: Parallel Cut
description: Cut along the line of the blade while a second track of qi runs beside it a hand's breadth away.

name: Parallelsteel Ward
description: Raise two tracks of qi along the blade so a blow that slips one meets the other.

name: Parallel Thrust
description: Thrust along the blade while a second line of qi runs beside the point to widen the wound.

name: Parallel Pace
description: Step along the track of the blade with the second track held ready for a change of line.

name: Dual Trackwork
description: Open the guard with the first track and send the second through the gap before it can close.

name: Paired Rebound
description: Turn a blow on one track of qi and let the other track spring back as a counter cut.

name: Parallel Sense
description: Run twin threads of qi along a stranger's blade to compare reach and grip and learn both.

name: Parallel Rend
description: Bring both tracks down together in one stroke that rends the guard along two lines at once.

name: Parallel Aegis
description: Hold two layered tracks of qi before the body so each blow must break one and then the other.

name: Sovereign Parallel
description: Gather both tracks of qi and cut so one binds the target's blade in place while the other lands.

name: Azure Cut
description: Cut with the edge glowing pale blue so the line of the stroke stays in the eye after it passes.

name: Azure Blade Ward
description: Raise the blade in a pale blue guard that takes a blow on clear and even qi.

name: Azure Bladeneedle
description: Thrust a needle of blue qi through a seam in the target's guard with the point as its tip.

name: Azure Bladestep
description: Step lightly on a thin trail of blue qi that holds the weight of the body for one pace.

name: Azure Draw
description: Draw the sword in a clean bright arc so the first stroke leaves a blue trace in the air.

name: Azure Rush
description: Surge forward on a bright blue line and cut as the feet land beyond the target's guard.

name: Azure Bladeveil
description: Draw a veil of thin blue qi across the front of the body to turn blows aside like silk.

name: Azure Bladebind
description: Wind a thread of blue qi about the target's blade and draw it tight so the weapon cannot lift.

name: Azure Gleam
description: Throw a bright sliver of blue qi that cuts and dazzles so the target loses the line of the blade.

name: Azure Rend
description: Drive a dense blue edge through the guard in a single stroke that parts steel as easily as cloth.

name: Azure Aegis
description: Hold a broad dome of layered blue qi over the wielder and nearby allies against sustained attack.

name: Sovereign Azure
description: Gather the azure edge into a great sweep that cuts every foe within reach of the blade in one pale arc.

name: Returnblade Cut
description: Cut out along a line and draw the blade back along the same line so the stroke is repeated.

name: Returnblade Ward
description: Meet a blow and let the blade flow with it then back so the force is carried away.

name: Returnblade Pace
description: Step out and back along one line in a heartbeat so the target's blow meets empty air.

name: Returning Edge
description: Cut out and turn the blow that answers it on the way back so the stroke ends as a guard.

name: Returnblade Flow
description: Flow from one cut to the next along a smooth curve so the blade seems never to stop.

name: Returnblade Sense
description: Let a thin line of qi go out along the blade and read from its return the shape of what it touched.

name: Returnblade Sweep
description: Send a wave of qi out in a wide sweep and draw it back along the same arc to cut every foe twice.

name: Returnblade Shell
description: Circle the blade so the shell of qi flows round the body and sends each blow back to its source.

name: Sovereign Returnblade
description: Meet the target's finest stroke with a cut that takes it in and returns it along the same line.

name: Azurewing Cut
description: Cut down from the wing of the guard with the blade pale blue and the stroke fast.

name: Azurewing Cover
description: Spread a wing of blue qi over the near side of the body to take one hard blow.

name: Azurewing Thrust
description: Dart the point forward like a diving wing tip and pierce the gap the target left open.

name: Azurewing Pace
description: Skim a low pace over the ground with the blade trailing a faint blue streak.

name: Azurewing Sight
description: Raise the blade high and let the blue qi sharpen the wielder's sight toward the far edge of the fight.

name: Azurewing Dive
description: Dive from a rising step to cut through the target's guard and land beyond its reach.

name: Azurewing Ward
description: Brush a blow off line with the blue edge and answer in the same sweep.

name: Azurewing Bind
description: Wrap blue threads about the target's weapon arm and hold it against the body.

name: Azurewing Spark
description: Flick a bead of blue qi from the point that darts straight at the target's face.

name: Azurewing Rend
description: Cut with the full spread of the wing so the edge rends guard and body in a long blue arc.

name: Azurewing Pinion
description: Spread pinions of qi to either side of the wielder to catch blows that come from the flank.

name: Azurewing Lance
description: Gather the wing of qi into a single lance at the point and drive it through the target.

name: Sovereign Azurewing
description: Pass through the target's guard on a blue pinion of qi and cut from behind it as it closes.

name: Oathsteel Cut
description: Cut as the oath demands along a single sworn line so the stroke does not wander.

name: Oathsteel Ward
description: Hold the blade to the sworn line so qi stiffens in the steel and takes the blow.

name: Oathsteel Pace
description: Advance a firm pace on the sworn line with the point held on the same bearing.

name: Oathsteel Thrust
description: Thrust along the oath without any flinch so the point goes exactly where it was sworn to go.

name: Oathsteel Edge
description: Cut with an edge made hard by the oath so no feint can turn the stroke from its line.

name: Oathsteel Parry
description: Turn the blow on the sworn line and cut back along it before the striker can recover.

name: Oathsteel Mark
description: Mark the line of the target's oath-bound or fixed stance and feel where it will not bend.

name: Oathsteel Rend
description: Cut with the whole weight of the oath so the edge rends through everything that stands on the line.

name: Oathsteel Aegis
description: Stand firm on the sworn line and let its qi shield the wielder and steady the allies beside.

name: Sovereign Oathsteel
description: Cut with the oath fully drawn so the stroke lands and seals the target's qi along the wound.

name: Unyielding Cut
description: Cut straight along the line without any bend of the wrist however the target moves.

name: Unyielding Ward
description: Plant the stance and hold the blade so the guard gives no ground against the blow.

name: Unyielding Pace
description: Press forward one step at a time into the target's reach and never give back a pace.

name: Unyielding Edge
description: Cut with an edge that takes the blow of the target's blade and does not turn.

name: Unyielding Parry
description: Meet a cut edge to edge and push it back while the answering stroke is already moving.

name: Unyielding Break
description: Break the rhythm of the target's attack by taking each stroke at its start with a hard counter.

name: Unyielding Rend
description: Drive the unbending edge through the target's defense in a single stroke that nothing turns aside.

name: Unyielding Shell
description: Hold a rooted shell of qi about the wielder that also firms the resolve of the wielder's cuts.

name: Sovereign Unyielding
description: Take the full force of a great blow on the blade and send the same stroke back through the striker.

name: Bearingblade Cut
description: Cut along the bearing taken at the start of the exchange with the blade true to the line.

name: Bearingblade Ward
description: Hold the blade on its bearing so a shell of qi stands where the blow must fall.

name: Bearingblade Thrust
description: Thrust along the held bearing so the point lands on the exact spot the line has marked.

name: Bearingblade Pace
description: Hold the bearing while taking a pace round the target so the point never leaves its line.

name: Bearingblade Mark
description: Send a thread of qi from the point along the bearing to feel where the target stands.

name: Bearingblade Edge
description: Cut on the bearing with an edge sworn to the wind so a feint cannot turn the line.

name: Bearingblade Parry
description: Turn the blow along the bearing and cut back on the same line.

name: Bearingblade Hold
description: Hold a line of qi from the point to the target's weapon so it cannot cross the bearing.

name: Bearingblade Surge
description: Surge along the bearing and cut at the end of it before the target has shifted.

name: Bearingblade Rend
description: Rend along the held bearing with an edge that nothing in the line can stop.

name: Bearingblade Aegis
description: Hold the bearing against a rising wind of blows with a rooted aegis of qi along the line.

name: Sovereign Bearingblade
description: Cut along the held bearing with an edge that wounds the target's body and the qi that guards it alike.

name: Openblade Cut
description: Cut from no set stance so the edge leaves the guard on a line the target did not read.

name: Openblade Ward
description: Let a shell of qi form only where the blow falls and leave the rest of the body free.

name: Openblade Thrust
description: Thrust from a slack hand so the point arrives from nowhere the target was watching.

name: Openblade Drift
description: Drift in a loose line past the target's guard with the blade trailing at ease.

name: Openblade Draw
description: Draw bare and wide with nothing barred so the first stroke can fall from any angle.

name: Openblade Edge
description: Cut with the edge free of any fixed path so each stroke picks its line in the moment.

name: Openblade Slip
description: Slip a blow by letting the body go loose and turning the force off with the blade.

name: Openblade Break
description: Break the rhythm of a fixed stance by cutting wherever the guard is not.

name: Openblade Rend
description: Cut free of every guard with the full force of the open edge to rend the target's defense.

name: Openblade Shell
description: Move without a fixed line while a loose shell of qi follows the body and meets each blow.

name: Sovereign Openblade
description: Flash across the target's reach with the blade unbarred and cut from the side it never guarded.

name: Longoath Cut
description: Cut as the long oath demands with the same measured stroke as the first of the fight.

name: Longoath Ward
description: Hold the guard to the oath through a long exchange so qi never thins along the blade.

name: Longoath Thrust
description: Thrust far and straight along the oath with the point steady to the end of the reach.

name: Longoath Pace
description: Take a long even pace that keeps the oath and the blade in line.

name: Longoath Mark
description: Hold the oath and sense along the blade where the target's strength is draining.

name: Longoath Edge
description: Cut with an edge that has not tired since the oath was sworn.

name: Longoath Parry
description: Turn the blow and return a cut on the oath line while the striker's weight is still forward.

name: Longoath Hold
description: Hold the target's blade to the oath line with a steady thread of qi until the striker tires.

name: Longoath Surge
description: Surge along the oath and cut at the end of the run with the weight of the whole body.

name: Longoath Rend
description: Rend through the target with the full strength the oath has stored across the long fight.

name: Longoath Aegis
description: Spread the oath over the wielder and nearby allies as a shell that also steadies their cuts.

name: Longoath Lance
description: Gather the stored oath into the point and loose one long lance of qi through the target.

name: Sovereign Longoath
description: Cut with the whole long oath behind the edge so the stroke lands and presses down the target's qi.

name: Bareblade Cut
description: Cut with the bare blade and no flourish so nothing stands between the edge and its mark.

name: Bareblade Ward
description: Hold the blade bare before the body and let a quick shell of qi meet the blow.

name: Bareblade Pace
description: Step simply on the held bearing with the bare point leading the body.

name: Bareblade Thrust
description: Thrust the bare point along the bearing so it reaches the mark with no wasted motion.

name: Bareblade Edge
description: Cut with a bare edge made keen by the bearing so the stroke goes through without drag.

name: Bareblade Parry
description: Turn the blow with the bare flat and cut back along the bearing at once.

name: Bareblade Sense
description: Leave the blade bare to the air and feel through it every shift in the target's weight.

name: Bareblade Rend
description: Rend along the bearing with a bare edge that finds nothing in the way it cannot part.

name: Bareblade Shell
description: Hold a thin even shell of qi round the bare blade and the body against the pressure of a long fight.

name: Sovereign Bareblade
description: Pass the bare blade through the target's guard as if it were not there and cut as it forms again.
